Through the Asha Kiran program, we are currently working with 3,500+ rural women, equipping them with essential livelihood skills to become livestock farmers. . Phase 1 of the program had already worked with 15,000 women, and the learning from Phase 1 is being incorporated into the phase 2 of the program. The livelihood ecosystem, including The Incubator and Accelerator, has supported 135+ social entrepreneurs, including 17 Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, and 1 Time Magazine cover story—clear indicators that we're backing the right people to create lasting change. Approximately INR 69 crores has been disbursed in grants, which has led to a 7.6X annual grant multiplier. The participating organizations have consistently rated us 9.5 on a scale of 10. Vision and Mission The/Nudge's vision is to achieve a poverty-free India by 2047, when India celebrates 100 years of independence. Its mission is to alleviate poverty sustainably by building resilient livelihoods through partnerships and evidence-based solutions.
